seo.title: Pricing — Ali Samadi | Creative Agency
seo.description: Simple, transparent pricing. Choose an all-inclusive monthly plan, a one-time upfront build, or a fully custom project — web design, hosting, CMS, and more.

hero.heading: Build Your
hero.text: Pick the plan that fits — an all-inclusive monthly plan, a one-time upfront build with light monthly add-ons, or a fully custom project scoped together.

plans.text: Go all-inclusive with a managed monthly plan, own your build with a one-time payment, or reach out for something fully custom.

monthly.title: Monthly
monthly.description: Everything included, one flat price — design, development, CMS, email, SEO, and hosting. Fully managed for you.

upfront.title: Upfront
upfront.description: Pay once for your website — design, development, and SEO included. Add pages anytime. Keep it running with light monthly add-ons.

custom.title: Custom
custom.description: Bigger scope? Admin panels, user accounts, databases, or something unique — we scope it together and quote it fairly.

disclaimer.text: A page is anything with its own address — Home, About, Contact, and so on; a long scrolling page still counts as one. Your first page is $500, and each page after that is $200. Terms & privacy pages are always free and don't count. You confirm the final page count at checkout before any work begins.
